name: Maccabi Online (מכבי אונליין) — member self-service portal
verified_how: Each route below with status V was loaded in a signed-in Chrome session (Claude in Chrome, desktop width) and its H1 and controls read. No form was submitted. Routes marked U were supplied by a user but not opened by the agent.

session.login: Out of scope for this version. The user signs in themselves; skills assume an authenticated Chrome profile.
signed_in_signals: header shows the patient switcher button whose text starts 'מציג פרטים של'
not_signed_in_signals: redirect to a login page (URL or H1 mentions כניסה / login)

access.plain_fetch: Useless for the portal (session-bound). For serguide.maccabi4u.co.il a plain fetch returned a bot-wall page at HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 — use the browser.
access.hydration: Single-page app. Content renders 2–5 s after navigation; the requests-status lobby is slower. An empty page read straight after navigation is NOT an empty result — wait and read again.

url_grammar.rule: Every portal route is /sonline/<section>/<page>/. Typing a path WITHOUT the /sonline/ prefix (which is how the side-menu hrefs are written) lands on a 404 page: H1 'לא מצאנו את העמוד שחיפשת'. With the prefix, direct navigation works.
never_record: query parameters carrying identifiers: relative=<hash>, sr_id=, req=<number>
any path segment of 6+ digits (member/ID numbers appear in some menu links, e.g. the Maccabi Pharm token link)
/go/<url-encoded> wrappers — record the decoded inner path only, without its query string

exceptions.vaccinations: H1 is just 'חיסונים' with no member suffix; each record line reads 'חיסונים עבור <name>'.

patient_switcher.find: header button whose accessible name starts 'מציג פרטים של' (Showing details of)
patient_switcher.options: Opening it lists one button per linked member (account holder plus linked children/dependants). Each button's text is first name immediately followed by the member's ID number.
patient_switcher.effect: Changes whose record every page shows until switched back.
patient_switcher.assert: After switching, the H1 suffix and the switcher label both carry the chosen member's first name.
patient_switcher.status: U — options read 2026-10-21, switch not exercised

home.contents: Quick actions row and tabs: עדכונים שלא קראת, הפניות בתוקף, תרופות ומרשמים, תורים עתידיים

doctor_messages.contents: Inbox of requests to and messages from doctors and the office. Filters: כל הבקשות, הודעות מהרופא/ה שלך, שאלות לרופא/ה; checkbox 'הציגו לי רק הודעות שלא קראתי או לא אישרת'. Button '+ בקשה חדשה'.
doctor_messages.deep_link: ?dl=true&req=<request id> opens one item — the id is account data, never record a real one
write_controls: קראתי את ההודעה (marks a message read/acknowledged)

options.label: איתור מסמכים בתיק שלך
options.covers: סיכום ביקור, הפניה, אישור רפואי ותוצאות בדיקות
options.note: self-service document finder, not a message

options.label: שליחת בקשה למשרד בנושאים
options.covers: התחייבות (טופס 17), אישור מקדים לתרופה, איתור שירות וזימון תורים והעתקי מסמכים

options.label: שליחת בקשה לרופא/ה בנושאים
options.covers: חידוש ובקשה למרשם, אישור מחלה, שאלה לרופא/ה, סיכום מצב רפואי והפניה
options.note: the usual choice — a message to the doctor

new_request.limits: Requests to the doctor are subject to a per-quarter quota (stated by the user; the exact number is shown in the flow, not recorded here).
new_request.status: V 2026-10-21 (landing and options); downstream form not opened

options.label: זימון תור לרופאים/ות והמטפלים/ות אצלם ביקרת בשנה האחרונה
options.covers: book from the member's own list of clinicians seen in the last year

options.label: חיפוש ואיתור שירותי בריאות
options.covers: search doctors, therapists, labs, urgent care, vaccination, medical centres

new_appointment.seasonal_banner: A flu-vaccine booking banner ('זימון תור לחיסון שפעת') appeared above the options on 2026-10-21; seasonal, do not rely on it.

future_appointments.contents: Cards: member, date, time, clinic type, clinician and location. Filter 'סינון לפי חברה'. Page text says to click the appointment details to view or cancel it.

request_status.contents: List of administrative requests (התחייבות / Form 17, refunds, medicine pre-approvals) with type, date submitted, status, and attachment icon. Filter 'מיין לפי' plus a 'הגשת בקשה חדשה' dropdown.
traps: Renders slower than other pages — a first read can be empty.

obligation_request.status: V 2026-10-21 (triage options); later steps not opened

medicine_preapproval.status: U — seen in menu only ('בקשה לאישור מקדים לתרופה')

refund_request.prompt: עבור איזה שירות ברצונך לקבל החזר?
refund_request.limit: Invoices up to 6,000 ₪ (page text: 'ניתן להגיש בקשה להחזר כספי לחשבוניות בסכום שאינו עולה על 6,000 ש״ח')
refund_request.requirements: Original receipt and tax invoice plus supporting documents as required; eligibility is assessed from the data entered.

no_card_visit.prompt: בחר סיבת הזמנת ביקור ללא כרטיס
terms: Approval is valid for 14 hours and is registered in Maccabi's systems — request it close to the visit.
Billed exactly as a card visit (quarterly levies apply where they would).
Not valid for labs or imaging institutes.

travel_insurance.behaviour: Redirects to the travel-insurance purchase flow and passes the member's medical record along (per the user). Opening it shares data with a third party.

test_results.contents: Cards: member, test/visit title, date performed, PDF ('לצפייה') button.

medications.contents: Cards: member, status (e.g. נופק / בתוקף), medication name in Latin capitals, prescriber and specialty, date; chevron expands details.
traps: The tabs are styled links, not role=tab — locate them by visible text.

medication_purchases.contents: Same page with the 'היסטוריית תרופות' tab selected and the prescription-status filter set to 'תרופות שנרכשו'. View ('לצפייה') and print ('להדפסה') controls for the report.

visit_summaries.contents: Cards: date, attachment icon, member, clinician, specialty, 'זימון תור חדש' link; chevron opens the summary.

my_doctor.contents: Assigned doctor and specialty, 'לשינוי הרופא שלי' link, specialties, clinic details (address, phone, appointment line, fax), weekly hours table (ימים / שעות פעילות), 'לזימון תור' button.
write_controls: לשינוי הרופא שלי — change of family doctor, allowed only periodically

vaccinations.contents: 'פנקס החיסונים שלי' with a PDF ('לצפייה') button, then one card per vaccine: name and date.
traps: H1 carries no member suffix — read the member from the card label 'חיסונים עבור <name>' or the switcher.
vaccinations.related: For children, Tipat Halav (טיפת חלב) keeps a parallel record outside Maccabi.

edit_profile.contents: Member card (name, ID, clinic, insurance tier), English name fields, personalised-services and accessibility preferences, contact details further down.

menu_only.note: Also in the side menu on 2026-10-21, not wrapped as skills yet: /sonline/medicalfile/documents/referrals/ (הפניות אישורים ודפי מידע), /sonline/medicalfile/Sensitivity (רגישות לתרופות), /sonline/medicalfile/ChildDevelopment/Lobby/, /sonline/directorship/ordermagneticcard/lobby/, /sonline/directorship/BabyRegistration/, /sonline/directorship/DebtPayment/, /sonline/directorship/CreditsAndDebits/DirectDebit/, plus medicalfile/summary, personalrecommendations and mailingsfromhospitals behind /go/ wrappers.

public_appeal.title: פניות הציבור מכבי
public_appeal.use: Public complaints / enquiries form — a second channel for following up items that stall inside the portal.

params.City: Israeli locality code (CBS סמל ישוב); 3000 = Jerusalem
params.RequestId: added by the site on redirect — omit it

branch_finder.access: Browser only; a plain fetch returned a bot-wall page at HTTP 200.
branch_finder.status: V 2026-10-21 (URL grammar); results page not parsed

never: submit any form, send any message, book/cancel an appointment, request a cardless-visit approval, change the doctor, or edit details without the user's explicit confirmation of that specific action in chat
open the travel-insurance redirect without confirmation — it shares medical data with a third party
write member names, ID numbers, request ids, hashes, doctor names or any record content into this repo
attempt to sign in, or handle credentials or one-time codes
